summary: A birth becomes a state record: the law requires a certificate for every birth.
realLife: State law requires a birth certificate to be completed for every birth, and the state forms feed a national count.
sources: CDC National Center for Health Statistics, NVSS Birth Data: https://www.cdc.gov/nchs/nvss/births.htm
inGame: the people module's life records, read by lifeOf in src/bench/loading.ts (the born/born event, with its year).

turns.what: No certificate is on file where the player was born: a late or missing record has to be filled in later.
turns.pulledBy: the home place's records and the birth year
turns.writesBack: a delayed-registration note on the person's born record, told in the loading story

turns.what: The certificate exists but the name or the date was entered wrong and corrected years later.
turns.pulledBy: a record fix on the person's file
turns.writesBack: a correction on the born record, which the card shows
